name: Fair-value-gap fill (LuxAlgo SMC)
why: Three 5-minute bars whose first high is below the third low left a one-sided move with no two-way business inside it; the first return into the gap fills the resting orders of the side that missed the move, and a close back above the gap top shows they were enough (mirror for shorts). Pre-registered 2026-10-18 (research/preregistered/2026-10-18_luxalgo_smc.md).

scan.when: (lag(5, fvgt(5)) == fvgt(5) && lo(5,1) < fvgt(5) && cl(5,1) > fvgt(5)) || (lag(5, fvgbs(5)) == fvgbs(5) && hi(5,1) > fvgbs(5) && cl(5,1) < fvgbs(5))
scan.dir: (lag(5, fvgt(5)) == fvgt(5) && lo(5,1) < fvgt(5) && cl(5,1) > fvgt(5)) - (lag(5, fvgbs(5)) == fvgbs(5) && hi(5,1) > fvgbs(5) && cl(5,1) < fvgbs(5))

stop: max(0.1*atr, 0.25 + max((lag(5, fvgt(5)) == fvgt(5) && lo(5,1) < fvgt(5) && cl(5,1) > fvgt(5))*(px - fvgb(5)), (lag(5, fvgbs(5)) == fvgbs(5) && hi(5,1) > fvgbs(5) && cl(5,1) < fvgbs(5))*(fvgts(5) - px)))
